title: Claude Code alternatives
summary: Claude Code alternatives: candidate paths, switching costs and reasons to keep the original.

sections.heading: Match the reason to a candidate
paragraphs: For visual iteration, trial Cursor. For provider configuration, inspect Cline. For a GitHub-oriented organization, examine the actual Copilot plan. Each path needs its own permission and data review.

sections.heading: When to keep the original
paragraphs: Keep Claude Code if the command loop is already reliable and your concern can be addressed with clearer permissions, smaller tasks or a reviewed billing configuration.

sections.heading: Migration rehearsal
paragraphs: Create a copy of the project, remove production secrets, export data using a documented method and run the tests in the candidate workflow. Compare the work needed to restore service after a failed change. Keep the original until the rehearsal succeeds.

verdict: Choose an alternative by the workflow or account boundary you need to change.
bestFor: Existing Claude Code users with a specific workflow, budget or ownership constraint
notFor: Readers expecting a replacement to move code, data and infrastructure automatically
migration: Trial the candidate on a branch; retain the original workflow until tests, export and billing checks pass.
gaps: Verify the account's Privacy Mode and team setting, use of personal API keys, enabled non-ZDR model approvals, Cloud Agent use and applicable agreement before drawing account-specific processing or retention conclusions; no account settings were inspected.

pros.text: Cursor documents an editor and coding-agent workflow for developers who want to keep editing and review in an IDE.
Cline documents IDE extension, CLI and desktop entry points, plus configurable provider options.

cons.text: The documented Copilot MCP route has a VS Code version requirement, and organization or enterprise policy can control availability on Business and Enterprise plans.
Claude Code project-scoped MCP servers require a trusted workspace and approval, so replacing the client does not remove the need to review tool permissions.

faqs.question: Which alternative documents local-model options?
faqs.answer: Cline documents Ollama and LM Studio options. Hardware and model suitability still need a workload-specific trial.

faqs.question: Does the Copilot MCP policy apply to every individual plan?
faqs.answer: GitHub scopes that policy to organization or enterprise users on Business or Enterprise plans; verify the actual account and organization configuration.

faqs.question: What does Cursor Privacy Mode cover, and what should an account verify?
faqs.answer: Cursor says Privacy Mode prevents training on Customer Data and that most model requests use provider zero-data-retention agreements, subject to safety and abuse review and non-ZDR model exceptions. Requests made with personal API keys still pass through Cursor's backend and rely on the provider's terms for retention. Optional Cloud Agents store encrypted repository copies while a run is active, then delete them after completion. Teams and Enterprise can enforce Privacy Mode; Cursor says individual plans follow its Privacy Policy rather than the commercial DPA. Verify the account setting, organization policy, model approvals, API-key route, Cloud Agent use and applicable agreement; none was inspected here.
